items.title: 52986_Lawrence Brown oral history interview
items.q: And a fellow by the name of Wilson was on piano... But they had a real fine band.

ctx.x: Oh, let's see. There was James Porter. He was a very good trumpet player. Very strong. You could hear him down about ten blocks. And, oh, let's see. Who else? William France was the tenor man, and Ashford Hardy was

the trombone. And his name is pretty big down in this area. And a fellow by the name of Wilson was on piano, but I can't remember his first name. But they had a real fine band. They were very popular.
How big a band was the Sunnyland Band?
